text: The owned patch clears gStatusFeedback and gSubscribableServer after the existing closeWindow call. Accepted cleanup also detaches subscribeListener before clearing the server. These writes describe retained references and cleanup order. They do not establish a measured memory leak or prove that an object was collected.
title: Subscription unload clears retained references in distinct source phases
